findings.outcome: Flaming black hounds breathe fire, resist Vorel fire, take frost and special radiant attacks, and all hounds in the encountered pack are killed by the E071 continuation.
findings.limits: No exact initial pack size, general cold/radiant vulnerability, universal death explosion or imported stat block. Vorel fire-resistance adjudication is corrected; security apes remain separate.

findings.outcome: Four corpse-bearing ice forms attack; one retreats, three released corpse attackers die, and Toby later speaks intelligibly about fearing Cerinthala would leave them.
findings.limits: Named companions and a reasoning survivor do not establish a non-intelligent species. Multiple corpses, shells and named individuals lack a complete one-to-one mapping; no all-four destruction or later Toby survival claimed.
